headline.purpose: The main result or proof line.

data.purpose: Domains, code, prices, and exact values.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Standard cards and small product objects.

motion.name: control-transform
motion.purpose: Menu icon transforms. Disable it for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a contained form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--primary-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet action that supports the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--secondary-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Reset Button
components.description: A reset action for a related group of filters. It is disabled at the defaults.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--secondary); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The standard text field for compact forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--foreground-soft); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Select
components.description: A compact native select for filters and sort order. Any is distinct from each explicit maximum.
components.css: .ds-select-label { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--foreground-soft); font: 500 0.75rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select-wrap { position: relative; display: block; color: var(--foreground-muted); } .ds-select { appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 2rem 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 20%, transparent); } .ds-select-wrap svg { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 0.625rem; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; transform: translateY(-50%); opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Segmented Filter
components.description: A small filter rail for one set of exclusive choices.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; gap: 0; padding: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--secondary); } .ds-filter button { padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground-muted); font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-filter button:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-filter button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--background-raised); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-filter button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Newsletter Card
components.description: A contained signup action after a useful result. It remains visible across visits.
components.html:
▲  Want the next list?

Get more useful finds and build notes from Ian's List.
components.css: .ds-newsletter { max-width: 32rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 8px 44px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-newsletter p { margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem; color: var(--foreground-muted); line-height: 1.4; } .ds-newsletter div { position: relative; } .ds-newsletter input { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 3rem 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-newsletter input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 20%, transparent); } .ds-newsletter button { position: absolute; top: 0.25rem; right: 0.25rem; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-newsletter button:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-newsletter button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Reference Table
components.description: A dense data list with one full-row registrar link for each record.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--foreground-muted); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-table th { padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-weight: 500; } .ds-table th:last-child, .ds-table td:last-child { text-align: right; } .ds-table td { position: relative; padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-table td:first-child, .ds-table td:last-child { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table a { color: var(--foreground); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-table a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 300%; } .ds-table tr { transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover, .ds-table tbody tr:has(a:focus-visible) { background: var(--secondary); } .ds-table tbody tr:has(a:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-table a:focus-visible { outline: none; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: The quiet site header with a menu toggle and one breadcrumb.
components.html: Ian Nuttall
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 1rem/1.5 'Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { display: grid; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav button svg { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--foreground-muted); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 0.25rem; }

narrative.overview:
Ian.is looks like a clear record of real work. It uses quiet neutral surfaces, direct type, small controls, and visible evidence. The result is useful before it is decorative. The design supports focused pages, posts, tools, and dated data without making them look like one generic product dashboard.

The system is compact but not cramped. It uses one centered reading frame, clear type levels, and thin dividers. Light and dark modes follow the operating system. Cards are for contained actions or distinct objects. Long reference data stays in lists or tables.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light and dark surfaces with one adaptive accent.
Static Sans for clear reading and JetBrains Mono for data.
A narrow centered frame with generous outer space.
Thin borders, compact controls, and restrained depth.
Direct proof, dates, and source details near the result.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the adaptive accent for action, focus, or status. Do not use it as broad decoration.

rules.name: The System Mode Rule
rules.body: Light and dark colors follow the operating system. Do not add a local mode that breaks the shared tokens.

rules.name: The Data Has a Voice Rule
rules.body: Use mono type only when the text is data or code. Keep prose and interface labels in Sans.

rules.name: The One Frame Rule
rules.body: Align the header, page content, tables, and footer to the same 48rem frame.

rules.name: The Flat First Rule
rules.body: Use a border or a surface change before you add a shadow.

rules.name: The Shape Follows Containment Rule
rules.body: Use larger corners for contained cards and smaller corners for controls. Keep long data structures square and divided.

dos: Do use the shared light and dark tokens on every new site surface.
Do align primary content to the 48rem frame.
Do show dates, sources, and limits close to time-sensitive results.
Do keep complete reference data visible and easy to scan.
Do use full-row links when one action applies to the complete row.
Do use the same focus treatment for buttons, inputs, selects, filters, and linked rows.
Do keep newsletter signup visible across visits.
Do give multi-control filter bars one clear reset action.
donts: Don't turn a long data set into a card grid.
Don't use cards for ordinary page sections or table rows.
Don't use the accent as broad decoration.
Don't use mono type for normal prose or interface labels.
Don't hide useful data behind newsletter signup.
Don't hide a newsletter card because a visitor subscribed before.
Don't use the largest explicit filter value to mean no limit.
Don't state that dated data is current without a check date and warning.
